params.body:
Builds the competitor list of Standard 0.17.0 (gentells-standard #22) into the checks and the writing prompts.

Until now only a *source row* a person marked was read for inspiration only (YPulse, Keeping Current). That misses a news article retelling a YPulse study, a WGSN link an author pastes in, and a trend whose text says "according to Canvas8". The list names the companies themselves, with their products, people and sites.

**One choke point, wider.** `inspirationSources(db)` now returns the marked rows plus every listed competitor as a flagged source without a row (`competitor: <id>`). Every check that already guarded marked sources now guards the competitors too, with no new call sites:
- the citation store refuses the evidence (409 in the Studio) with "X is a competitor: Gentells does not name, cite or link it. Go back to the primary source."
- the publish gate holds a piece that names one ("names WGSN, a competitor Gentells does not name") or still cites one
- the projection leaves such a citation out of a post, and such a signal out from under a trend
- the writers and suggestions are never offered such material

**Further for competitors:**
- links are matched on the company's sites and pages (`beanostudios.com/beano-brain`), not only on a row's own site
- names are matched on products and people too (The Viral List, Student Beans, LS:N Global, Matt Klein); names that are ordinary words only as written or in a longer form (Pion, ZINE, Young Works, Keeping Current, Most Contagious)
- a signal whose own text names one (notes, or the first 4,000 characters of its content) is theirs, whatever site carried it
- the Edelman Trust Barometer is blanked out before any name is matched, and `edelman.com/trust` is claimed by no source, including the marked Edelman row

**Trends.** `projection-trends` leaves out a trend whose own words (headline, summary, reading) name a competitor, until it is rewritten from the primary source.

**Writers.** `COMPETITOR_RULE`, built from the list (so a company added in a release reaches the prompts without retyping), is appended to `HEADLINE_VOICE` (and so `TREND_VOICE`), `READING_VOICE` and `TREND_HEADLINE`: never name, cite, link or retell them; write from the primary source; the Trust Barometer is the one exception. The comment on `voice.mjs` no longer describes the house register as distilled from two competitors.

**`bin/competitor-audit.mjs`** (read-only, `--out` for JSON): source rows that are a competitor and not yet marked (`--mark-sources --by=<person>` marks them), posts that name or cite one, trends on the site now left out, how many signals under trends are now left out, and report titles and summaries. The report files themselves are not read. Citations in posts are taken off with the existing `bin/inspiration-only.mjs --apply --run=<name>` (with `--undo`); the sentences are the writer's.

**Until the pin.** `packages/core/competitors.mjs` carries the list as the Standard proposes it; once `v0.17.0` is pinned, `STANDARD.rules.competitors` takes over and the local copy can go. The test carries the Standard's 30 conformance cases.

**Tests.** `test/competitors.test.mjs` (new). `test/inspiration.test.mjs` tested marking with YPulse and Edelman, which are now always flagged; its fixtures are fictional publishers (Pulsewire, Brightline), so it keeps testing marking on its own. Full suite 1346 of 1352: the 6 `report-render` failures need pdftoppm and fail on main too. `tsc` clean.

**On the box after deploy:**
```
node --env-file=.env bin/competitor-audit.mjs --out=competitor-audit.json
node --env-file=.env bin/competitor-audit.mjs --mark-sources --by=<person>
node --env-file=.env bin/inspiration-only.mjs                      # look first
node --env-file=.env bin/inspiration-only.mjs --apply --run=competitors-1
```

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
params.title: Competitors are never named, cited or linked (Standard 0.17.0)
